parsed.why: Top-tier: public-accommodations anti-discrimination since 2008, facilities access for all genders (2023), GI hate-crime with a conviction, shield law, court forcing care resumption. Residual exposure is only the shared hostile national border/detention layer.

Governor's 2023 order defines sex at birth and backs single-sex spaces; surgery-based IDs, under-19 care ban, no state GI hate-crime or anti-discrimination law; trans prisoner celled with a male sex offender, failure-to-protect claims dismissed.

Strong: public-accommodations anti-discrimination since 2007, GI hate-crime since 1999, panic-defence repeal, shield laws protecting travelling trans patients, gender-neutral single-user restrooms. Facilities protection narrower than slot 1.

Bathroom/locker ban in schools and government buildings, complaint form, and no defence route for out-of-state documents; flag ban; under-19 care ban. Offsetting: GI hate-crime statute, employment/housing protection, amendable markers.

Broadest facilities law (restrooms, changing and sleeping quarters) with a private cause of action; no state public-accommodations, employment or housing protection; no state hate-crime statute; rated among the worst for targeting trans adults.
